interfaceCtat.descricao: Interface FIXA do tutor (a mesma tela para todos os problemas): enunciado; pergunta "What is the fraction in the problem?" com duas caixas numéricas (f1 em cima = numerador, f2 embaixo = denominador); reta numérica de 0 a 1 (numline) onde o aluno marca um ponto, com encaixe em 8 partes por unidade (marcas ocultas), pontos rotulados; botão Hint; botão Done. Os passos do aluno são ações NESSES componentes (digitar nos campos, converter, marcar o ponto, concluir).

campo: numerador da parte fracionária do número misto ("-" quando não há)

reta numérica; o aluno adiciona um ponto (marca a posição da fração)
grupo com m1/m2/m3, exibido depois de Convert
botão "Convert": abre as caixas do número misto (m1, m2, m3) para reescrever a fração
campo numérico da caixa de cima da fração (numerador)
campo numérico: parte inteira do número misto

dicas.texto: The denominator tells how many equal parts make up the whole garden.
Look for the number that describes all the tomato plants before any were eaten.
The garden consists of a total of eight tomato plants.
Type the total number of plants into the lower fraction box.
The numerator represents the part of the garden that the question asks you to show.
Find the unharmed part by subtracting the eaten plants from the total plants.
Use the total of 8 plants and remove the 2 plants eaten by the deer.
Complete the subtraction and type the remaining number into the upper fraction box.
A fraction is less than 1 when the selected part is smaller than the whole.
Compare the numerator with the denominator without changing either number.
Check whether the number of unharmed plants is smaller than the total number of plants.
Keep the fraction model showing six selected parts out of eight total parts, then confirm the displayed fraction.
The denominator tells how many equal intervals divide the distance from 0 to 1.
Start at 0 and move one equal interval at a time toward 1.
Use eight equal intervals for the whole distance and count the unharmed portion from the left.
Place the point at the interval reached after counting six equal steps from 0.
A mixed number separates complete wholes from the remaining fractional part.
Determine how many complete groups of eight fit into six.
Because the numerator is smaller than the denominator, there is no complete whole.
After selecting Convert, enter zero in the whole-number field and keep the fractional part unchanged.

exercicio.statement:
Sally's aunt has a small tomato garden in her backyard, and it consists of 8 tomato plants. One day, a hungry deer passed by and ate 2 of her tomato plants. Show how much of Sally's aunt's tomato garden is unharmed on the number line.
What is the fraction in the problem?
